result.description: Dynamic Support Services   About the Role   Dynamic Support Services Pty Ltd is seeking an experienced Senior Residential Care Officer to provide care, supervision and senior support for people with disability. The successful applicant will support participants with complex behavioural, psychosocial and high risk needs, assist with support planning, monitor participant progress, respond to incidents, and provide guidance to Residential Care Officers in the delivery of participant care.   Tasks & Responsibilities    Provide care, supervision and support for people with disability living in supported accommodation.  Assess participants’ day to day needs and assist them to access appropriate support options.  Implement and monitor Behaviour Support Plans, Risk Assessments and Incident Management Protocols.  Monitor participant progress and report changes in health, wellbeing, behaviour or support needs.  Support participants to access community, education, training, health and social support services.  Refer participants to relevant agencies, professionals or services where additional assistance is required.  Support behavioural de-escalation and respond to incidents and emergencies in a safe manner.  Liaise with families, Guardians, Support Coordinators, Behaviour Support Practitioners, Allied Health Professionals, NSW Ambulance, NSW Police and hospitals.  Maintain accurate progress notes, incident reports, behavioural records, medical records and compliance documentation.  Ensure support is delivered in line with NDIS Practice Standards, organisational policies and relevant legislation.  Provide guidance and support to Residential Care Officers in the delivery of participant care.    Qualifications & Experience   Essential criteria:   Certificate IV or higher in Disability, Community Services, Aged Care or an equivalent relevant qualification.  At least 5 years of relevant experience in disability support, residential care, supported accommodation, complex behaviour support or a similar community services setting.  Experience in a senior role within disability, residential care or community services.  Knowledge of NDIS Practice Standards, behaviour support, restrictive practices, incident reporting and safeguarding.  Current NSW driver’s licence.  Current First Aid and CPR certification.  NDIS Worker Screening Check and Working with Children Check, or willingness to obtain.  Strong communication, documentation and problem solving skills.  Commitment to participant wellbeing, safeguarding and person-centred care. Employer: Salt Restaurants PTY LTD T/As Salt Indian Cuisine Padbury
Location: 5/4 Warburton Ave, Padbury, Western Australia 6025
Position: Chef (Full-Time)
Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum (depending on experience)

About Us

Salt Restaurants PTY LTD T/As Salt Indian Cuisine Padbury, is a well-established Indian restaurant located in Padbury, Western Australia 6025. Renowned for its authentic Indian cuisine, exceptional customer service, and welcoming dining experience, Salt Indian Cuisine serves customers from Padbury and surrounding Northern suburbs. Our commitment to quality ingredients, traditional cooking techniques, and innovation has earned us a loyal customer base and an excellent reputation within the local community.
As our business continues to grow, we are looking for a passionate and skilled Chef to join our kitchen team and contribute to delivering outstanding dining experiences for our guests.

Key Responsibilities

Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes in accordance with established recipes and quality standards.
•	Planning menus and assisting with the development of new menu items.
•	Monitoring food preparation and presentation to ensure consistency and high standards.
•	Managing food stock levels and assisting with ordering supplies.
•	Ensuring compliance with food safety, hygiene, and workplace health and safety regulations.
•	Supervising and training kitchen staff when required.
•	Maintaining a clean and organised kitchen environment.


Skills and Experience
To be successful in this role, you should have:
•	Minimum 2-3 years of experience working as a Chef.
•	Relevant culinary qualifications (Certificate III in Commercial Cookery or equivalent preferred).
•	Strong knowledge of food preparation techniques and kitchen operations.
•	Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
•	Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
•	A positive attitude and strong teamwork skills.

What We Offer

Full-time permanent position with a salary of $75,000 – $85,000 per annum (depending on experience).
A supportive and friendly team environment.
Opportunity to work in a well-established and growing hospitality business.
Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
A dynamic and fast-paced workplace where your skills and creativity are valued.
Stable employment with opportunities for long-term career growth.
Staff meals during rostered shifts and other employee benefits
